records.issue_text: [Low/bug] app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6:36-38 — after saving with no category selected, the server defaults `category_id` to uncategorized, but the client overwrites `host.category` with `Discourse.Category.findById(null)` (undefined), so the row renders a blank category until refresh and a subsequent edit derives a broken categoryId.
records.rationale: Verified from the diff: `categoryId: null` is initialized and only set in the `edit()` action; `save()` sends `props.category_id = this.get('categoryId')` and then sets `host.category = Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId'))`, which with a null categoryId returns undefined even though the server defaults to uncategorized (`host.category_id = SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id if host.category_id.blank?`). So the client renders a blank category and derives a broken categoryId on subsequent edit, exactly as described.
